items.title: Are requests/demands coming from AI companies for regulation genuine?
items.raw_excerpt: Lately I have been hearing a lot of people from AI companies asking for regulation and expressing fear on AI's capabilities. Are these genuine, or do they now realize that there is a financial bubble and they are trying to deflate it a bit? It seems that it is too late for regulation to kick in. It has to be an international body and it will take forever to come to a consensus and give this body some teeth. On the other hand, if the growth is exponential, it is not surprising that you notice too late to do anything substantial. How can we tell if these requests are genuine or not? I am inclined to think that they are, after listening to the CNN interview; but it sounds so strange.

items.raw_excerpt: 9月16日，记者从相关渠道获悉，AI制药公司Anew Labs（新生实验室）日前已完成首轮独立融资，融资总额 2.9 亿美元。本轮投资方涵盖红杉中国、IDG资本、高瓴创投、五源资本、高榕资本等投资机构，同时有多家国内医药产业集团作为战略投资方参与。 今年 6 月，据媒体报道，字节跳动将 AI 制药业务线拆分独立，核心团队、算法平台及已有管线资产整体注入新主体，由原团队负责人刘凯负责，核心成员约 50 人，涵盖 AI 算法与制药领域专家。拆分后的主体品牌定为Anew Labs（新生实验室）。 业内分析认为，Anew Labs（新生实验室）此次融资，是希望以独立主体吸引更多行业人才与战略资源、围绕AI制药业务建立适合的组织激励形式。 截至发稿， Anew Labs （新生实验室）和字节跳动均未对此消息置评。 雷峰网 雷峰网

This is done to increase utility, ensure safety, and improve the experience of the people interacting with the model. However, values are complex and inter-related – inducing one could modify behaviour on another.
